HELP & SUPPORT

Frequently asked
questions

Start here for general information about the community and GTA V Port for iOS.

Ask the community ↗
What is this website?+

This is an independent community hub for GTA V on iOS. It brings together news, project updates, and general guidance. Discord is our main community space.

Where can I join the community?+

Use the Discord links on this website to join the server once the invite is available. Discussions, support, and community announcements take place there.

Where can I find the app and installation guide?+

Five Star Port provides links to its app releases and setup instructions. Check the current guide before installing. This website does not host app or game files. Visit Five Star Port ↗

Which iPhones are supported?+

Compatibility depends on your device, iOS version, available memory, and the port release. Check the current requirements in the project guide.

Do I need my own game files?+

Yes. Use files from a copy of the game you own and follow the file requirements in the installation guide. Game files are not provided here.

Is this an official Rockstar Games community?+

No. This is an independent community and is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All game names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
